raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.204.2"
  python_check_max: "3.14"

package:
  name: sonatype-iq-api-client
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/s/sonatype-iq-api-client/sonatype_iq_api_client-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5a1cfbc97c44880f2691df1ab1814d94a382f802c74c40e54a5d2bd73b564ff1

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script:
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - poetry-core
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools
  run:
    - pydantic >=2
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - python-dateutil >=2.8.2
    - typing_extensions >=4.7.1
    - urllib3 >=2.1.0,<3.0.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - sonatype_iq_api_client
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - ${{ python_check_max }}.*

about:
  summary: Sonatype Lifecycle Public REST API
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/sonatype-iq-api-client
  repository: https://github.com/sonatype-nexus-community/nexus-iq-api-client

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - bollwyvl
